findings.title: Incorrect Return Type Fixes in Future<File?> Methods
findings.description: Automated script changed 'return null;' to 'return false;' in methods that return Future<File?>. This is incorrect - bool cannot be returned from a method with return type Future<File?>.
findings.evidence: Line 730: if (!context.mounted) return false; // Should be: return null;
findings.impact: Image compression and PDF creation methods fail to compile, breaking image upload functionality throughout the app
findings.fix: Change 'return false;' back to 'return null;' in all Future<File?> methods, or remove the unreachable 'return null;' statements that follow

findings.title: Incorrect Return Type Fixes in void Methods
findings.description: Automated script changed 'return null;' to 'return false;' in void methods. Void methods cannot return any value.
findings.evidence: Line 1929 in DetailsPage_server.dart: void _showProgressDialog(String message) { if (!context.mounted) return false; ... }
findings.impact: Progress dialog methods fail to compile, breaking user feedback during long operations
findings.fix: Change 'return false;' to 'return;' (no value) in all void methods

findings.title: Unfixed Return Type Issues in Future<bool> Methods
findings.description: Methods returning Future<bool> still have 'return null;' statements that were not fixed. Null cannot be returned from a method with return type Future<bool>.
findings.evidence: Line 410 in induction.dart: Future<bool> _performLivenessCheck() async { if (!context.mounted) return null; ... }
findings.impact: Geofencing and liveness check methods fail to compile, preventing learner check-in functionality
findings.fix: Change all 'return null;' to 'return false;' in Future<bool> methods

findings.title: Incorrect Return Values in Future<void> Closures
findings.description: Closures with Future<void> return type have 'return false;' statements. Bool cannot be returned from Future<void>.
findings.evidence: Line 1198 in POECollectionPage.dart: closure returns bool where Future<void> is expected
findings.impact: POE collection and image capture callbacks fail to compile
findings.fix: Remove 'return false;' statements from Future<void> closures, or change to just 'return;'

findings.title: Missing Return Values in Non-void Methods
findings.description: Methods with explicit return types have 'return;' without values
findings.evidence: Line 170 in finance_attendance_calendar.dart: return; // Missing value
findings.impact: Finance module attendance features fail to compile
findings.fix: Add appropriate return values or change return type to void

findings.title: Import References Non-existent File
findings.description: Import statements reference 'backup_clock_in_page.dart' which does not exist in the lib directory
findings.impact: Clock-in and dashboard pages fail to compile. BackupClockInPage class is undefined, causing additional undefined_method errors
findings.fix: Either create the missing backup_clock_in_page.dart file or remove the import and any code that references BackupClockInPage
